episode_title: Ep. 176 Season 6: Just Dill With It

real_qa.q: What percentage of Precision Healthcare Consultants' revenue was lost due to canceled federal contracts in 2025?
real_qa.r: According to Inc. Magazine, canceled contracts represented approximately 15% of Precision Healthcare Consultants' revenue in 2025 when changes in federal contracting policies disrupted the company's work with government healthcare agencies.

real_qa.q: How many countries and continents does Precision Healthcare Consultants currently serve?
real_qa.r: Precision Healthcare Consultants reports serving organizations across 14 countries and three continents, having expanded its international presence including establishing an office in Nairobi, Kenya.

real_qa.q: What percentage of surveyed employer businesses reported challenges reaching customers and growing sales according to the Federal Reserve Bank 2026 report?
real_qa.r: According to the Federal Reserve Bank's 2026 report on employer firms, 57% of surveyed employer businesses with fewer than 500 employees reported challenges reaching customers and growing sales.
real_qa.requete: Federal Reserve 2026 employer firms sales challenges 57%

real_qa.q: What payment delays can occur for signed contracts beyond the standard 30-day invoice terms?
real_qa.r: Even when invoices state payment is due in 30 days, payment can stretch to 90, 120, 180 days or longer, while payroll, contractors, rent, technology and other expenses don't wait.

real_qa.q: What percentage of surveyed employer businesses reported uneven cash flow in the Federal Reserve Bank's 2026 report?
real_qa.r: According to the Federal Reserve Bank's 2026 report on employer firms covering businesses with fewer than 500 employees, 50% reported uneven cash flow.

real_quote: Don't confuse activity with impact. A busy calendar doesn't necessarily mean a profitable business.
